concerns.text: The plan assumes the presence of UPDRS III scores for each patient (e.g., computing per‑patient UPDRS III slopes), but `research.md` explicitly states that UPDRS III is not available in any verified PPMI dataset. This makes FR‑004 impossible to satisfy without an additional data source, violating the functional requirement and the project's data‑availability assumptions.

The plan describes storing intermediate results (e.g., filtered samples, CLR‑transformed abundances, per‑patient slope tables) but does not name the concrete files defined in `data-model.md` (`data/processed/filtered_samples.parquet`, `data/processed/clr_abundances.parquet`, `data/processed/patient_taxon_slopes.parquet`, `data/processed/patient_updrs_slopes.parquet`). Adding these filenames would align the plan with the data model and improve traceability.
